learning_outcomes.text: Can classify raw data, prepare frequency distributions, and calculate measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) for a series.
Can calculate measures of central dispersion (standard deviation, variance, skewness, kurtosis, moment) for a series.
Can perform probability calculations in standard normal distribution.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Probability and Probability Theory
Introduction to Statistics, Data Collection Methods
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated with a 50% contribution from semester work and a 50% contribution from the final exam. The midterm exam constitutes 100% of the semester work contribution.
